en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional wedding-themed song. 'невиднина' (unseen, i.e. endless or not yet seen) is my reading.

lines.cyr: Ѓерданот ми тропна, свадба ќе се прави, џанам,
lines.lat: Ǵerdanot mi tropna, svadba ḱe se pravi, džanam,
lines.en: My necklace clinked, a wedding will be held, my dear,

lines.cyr: свадба ќе се прави, мома ќе се мажи.
lines.lat: svadba ḱe se pravi, moma ḱe se maži.
lines.en: a wedding will be held, a girl will be married.

lines.cyr: Ѓерданот ми тропна, на мама ѝ текна, џанам,
lines.lat: Ǵerdanot mi tropna, na mama ì tekna, džanam,
lines.en: My necklace clinked, it occurred to mother, my dear,

lines.cyr: на мама ѝ текна, на тате ќе каже,
lines.lat: na mama ì tekna, na tate ḱe kaže,
lines.en: it occurred to mother, she will tell father,

lines.cyr: на тате ќе каже, тате ќе ме маже, џанам,
lines.lat: na tate ḱe kaže, tate ḱe me maže, džanam,
lines.en: she will tell father, father will marry me off, my dear,

lines.cyr: тате ќе ме маже на богато место.
lines.lat: tate ḱe me maže na bogato mesto.
lines.en: father will marry me off to a rich place.

lines.cyr: Мене ќе ме маже многу надалеку, џанам,
lines.lat: Mene ḱe me maže mnogu nadaleku, džanam,
lines.en: He will marry me off very far away, my dear,
very far away, to a rich place,
a house, household goods, an unseen vineyard, my dear,
an unploughed field, a hard-working lad.

lines.cyr: Свадба ќе се прави, невеста ќе бидам, џанам,
lines.lat: Svadba ḱe se pravi, nevesta ḱe bidam, džanam,
lines.en: A wedding will be held, I will be a bride, my dear,

lines.cyr: невеста ќе бидам, оро ќе се игра,
lines.lat: nevesta ḱe bidam, oro ḱe se igra,
lines.en: I will be a bride, the oro will be danced,

lines.cyr: оро ќе се игра, невеста ќе бидам, џанам,
lines.lat: oro ḱe se igra, nevesta ḱe bidam, džanam,
lines.en: the oro will be danced, I will be a bride, my dear,

lines.cyr: невеста ќе бидам, свадба ќе се прави.
lines.lat: nevesta ḱe bidam, svadba ḱe se pravi.
lines.en: I will be a bride, a wedding will be held.
